population: All32 preselected development origins,4 evaluator query kinds each; no outcome-based replacement or stratum coercion

coverage.whole_question_denominator: SOLVABLE with semantically reviewed E* family
coverage.partial: PARTIALLY_SOLVABLE allowed-answer support coverage separate; whole-query N/A
coverage.insufficient_unknown: Whole-question N/A; unknown annotation utility not fabricated
coverage.miss_label: NO_ENUMERATED_SET_COVERED unless reviewed alternative-set completeness supports stronger interpretation
coverage.candidate_and_delivery: Exact same-source/hash codepoint union; candidate IDs, plan selection and actual HTTP delivery separate

semantic_utility.rubric: Per-query frozen anchors; supported uncertainty can earn1; material unsupported certainty and excessive refusal separate
semantic_utility.aggregation: Report by four query kinds and solvability; no undefined overall mixed-task accuracy
semantic_utility.review: Single developer semantic review on method-hidden output copies, with limits explicit; no independent Judge claim

G1_query_conditions: At least two source-compatible relation interpretations produce different answer constraints before relevant disambiguating evidence is consumed.
Frozen full archive contains semantically reviewed disambiguating evidence with supported answer constraints.
Evaluator can exhibit actual complete public units inside shared K32 covering an enumerated whole-query E* with common render/tokenizer cost<=2048.

B1 and B2 actual deliveries leave the relevant relation-disambiguation gap; mere missing primitive public edges, ordinary BM25 misses, oversized atomic chain packaging or technical reasoning errors are identified separately.
Reader errors when sufficient evidence was actually delivered do not count as a selector relation-disambiguation gap.
Missing/effective-unknown metadata or B2 fallback alone does not establish that strong temporal approaches have been eliminated.
G1_group_decision: No automatic Go from an aggregate error rate. Report every qualifying query/history and source-family dependence; require recurrence across more than one distinguishable source history and a defensible relation mechanism. If source independence or alternatives remain unresolved, G1 remains insufficient rather than passed. Any expansion or Simplify/Stop decision must preserve all current cases/results and state its scope.
uncertainty: T0 is descriptive development diagnosis, not a formal significance/generality claim. Multiple questions and repeats are nested within origin, with known derived-family sensitivity. Formal M-vs-B3/B4 inference remains gated and NOT_RUN.
model_retry_policy: No repeated answer attempts, no answer rewriting, no automatic transport retries; capacity not admitted, budget failure, transport unknown and semantic wrong are different statuses.
B4: Finite reference verified; natural shared outcome model unavailable, NOT_RUN; no superiority claim.
method_changes_after_revelation: No reusing this T0 collection as unseen test. Interface corrections preserve failure artifacts and require explicit nonsemantic justification; semantic/ranking revisions consume a declared development iteration.
